title: Leitvia Studio building block
description: An entry of the registry building_blocks: a part of the content model with the patterns that show it, default values of its site settings and sample entries, added to a site as one unit by the ability leitvia/add-building-block. The model is checked against content-model.schema.json; samples is a path to a JSON file or, in PHP, a callable.

model.description: Content model entries the block brings: postTypes, taxonomies, relations and settings, without version.

patterns.description: Names of the registered patterns that show the content of the block.

settings.description: Default values of site settings of the content model by key, written only while a setting is empty.

samples.description: Absolute path to a JSON file with sample entries: one object of postType, terms and entries, or a list of them.
